It is also agreed that if she incur losses, the losses will be shared by me also. Further she said after deducting all the maintenance expenses etc., the profit will be calculated each year. It was also agreed that whenever I want I can discontinue the business with her and I will get back my whole invested amount. answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 14738 Country: India Title: Assalam alikum, Please Help Me Out. I did a shopping of rs. 50000/ with credit card, later on i converted that amount as EMI for 3 months, it is 0% interest (Interest free), and service charge of 2%. Is this legal? Jazakallah! Question: Assalam alikum, Please Help Me Out. I did a shopping of rs. 50000/ with credit card, later on i converted that amount as EMI for 3 months, it is 0% interest (Interest free), and service charge of 2%. Is this legal? Jazakallah! Answer ID: 14738 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1245/258=TL/1430) You are allowed to purchase if you have not to give interest while paying the price. The service charge deducted by the bank is lawful. Nevertheless, you can do shopping through credit card if you are not asked to pay interest. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
